item.title: GreenJackets announce coaching staff for 2026 season
item.description: The Augusta GreenJackets, in conjunction with the Atlanta Braves, have announced their coaching staff for the 2026 season, naming Brad Stoll as the team’s new manager. The post GreenJackets announce coaching staff for 2026 season appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: ASMP inmate formally charged in January stabbing death in Columbia County
item.description: Authorities have arrested and charged a 25-year-old inmate with murder in the Jan. 20 stabbing death of fellow inmate Jerry W. Merritt at Augusta State Medical Prison. The post ASMP inmate formally charged in January stabbing death in Columbia County appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Burger King employee hit with new charges for pulling gun & making threats
item.description: The man at the center of a Burger King feud involving a gun and several employees has now been charged with more serious offenses and denied bond. The Richmond County Sheriff’s Office says the trouble began around 5:34 p.m. on Jan. 22 at the Burger King on Deans Bridge Road in Augusta. item.title: Minimum speed limit on Georgia highways could rise by 10 mph
item.description: Get out of the way, slow drivers. The minimum speed limit on Georgia highways might increase to 50 mph. The post Minimum speed limit on Georgia highways could rise by 10 mph appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Irish American Heritage Society announces 2026 St. Patrick’s Day honorees
item.description: The Irish American Heritage Society has announced its 2026 St. Patrick’s Day dignitaries, naming Worth Andrews as Grand Marshal, Karen Mulherin Brooks as Irish Lady of the Year and the James and Ashlyn Hutto family as Irish Family of the Year. The post Irish American Heritage Society announces 2026 St. Patrick’s Day honorees appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: North Augusta High School cuts ribbon on new Jacket Park
item.description: North Augusta High School principal Casey Rogers cut the ribbon Friday at the new Jacket Park, the school's long-awaited on-campus baseball and softball complex. The post North Augusta High School cuts ribbon on new Jacket Park appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta releases names of finalists for planning director
item.description: The Augusta government has released the names of two candidates under consideration for the open position of planning and development director. The post Augusta releases names of finalists for planning director appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Aiken teen accused of stealing nude images from woman’s phone and posting them online
item.description: An Aiken teen was locked up this week for posting images of a woman using nude images from her stolen phone, authorities said. The post Aiken teen accused of stealing nude images from woman’s phone and posting them online appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta teen cleared in ‘Water Boys’ killing now wanted in armed kidnapping
item.description: An Augusta teen who was previously cleared in last summer’s high-profile “Water Boys” killing is now wanted in connection with a violent kidnapping involving a gun. The post Augusta teen cleared in ‘Water Boys’ killing now wanted in armed kidnapping appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County resident petitions for judicial review of quarry rezoning amid data center controversies
item.description: The Economic Development Authority of Columbia County’s (EDACC) request to rezone Appling land to develop data centers for its White Oak Tech Park expansion is going back before the county, with a hearing scheduled at the Planning Commission on March 5. A portion of the Appling properties, some 37 acres, was erroneously advertised under the wrong parcel number.
